Class CraftTweakerTransaction

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.compat.crafttweaker.CraftTweakerTransaction
public final class CraftTweakerTransaction extends Object
Collects molecule and tag changes in ZenScript and applies them together when commit is called.

Use a named transaction when related changes must all succeed or all be rejected. Committing consumes this draft; start another draft for the next update. The returned job reports completion and controls cleanup for the set it installed. Other registration sets are unaffected.
